task.original_goal: Add isolated deterministic standard-library regression tests for corrupted or inconsistent compressed offline full-text search index shards/manifests, verifying checker failures and actionable diagnostics. Preserve normal valid index behavior and stable article IDs; no Android or shipped content changes.
task.roadmap_source: docs/OFFLINE_SEARCH_BULK_ROADMAP.md S1/S5; missing/corrupt index diagnostics and stable-ID coverage
task.implementation_hint: Inspect scripts/check_fulltext_index.py and existing test harnesses; use temporary synthetic index/manifest fixtures, narrow checker refactor only if needed; test exact-head on a scoped read-only public CI runner.

acceptance_criteria: Valid minimal synthetic search manifest and gzip shard pass checker without repository-generated assets.
Missing referenced shard, invalid/truncated gzip and malformed JSON fail nonzero with shard-specific diagnostics.
Manifest/postings mismatches, unknown article IDs and invalid shard mapping fail nonzero with actionable diagnostics where existing schema supports them.
Tests use stdlib and temporary fixtures, preserve valid-index CLI behavior, do not modify generated/shipped assets, and avoid dependencies on unmerged PRs #22–#24.
Run scoped read-only public CI at exact task head; capture URL, SHA, exit codes and test count; distinguish isolated from integration/Android verification.
excluded_scope: No Android/device/UI or full app claims
No shipped articles or safety publication
No index format or tokenization changes unless explicitly approved
No third-party dependencies, production hooks, auto-merge or release
